tools.description: Execute an arbitrary GraphQL query against the First Street v3 API. Use this for complex or custom queries not covered by the other tools. Provide a valid GraphQL query string and optional variables.
tools.name: execute_graphql

tools.description: Find buildings within a geographic area defined by a GeoJSON polygon. Returns building locations, asset types, and Place IDs. Area must not exceed 9 km².

area.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon defining the search area (max 9 km²)

tools.name: find_buildings

tools.description: Get climate adaptation recommendations and cost-benefit analysis for a property. Shows possible flood barriers, fire-proofing, defensible space, roof upgrades, and wind design improvements with payback periods.

holdPeriod.description: hold period of the asset in years

ssp.description: socio-economic pathway: SSP_1_26 (optimistic) or SSP_2_45 (moderate) or SSP_5_85 (pessimistic)

tools.name: get_adaptations

tools.description: List all supported asset type IDs with human-readable descriptions (residential, commercial, industrial, infrastructure, etc.).
tools.name: get_asset_types

tools.description: Look up locality (country, state, county, or metro area) data by locality ID. Returns macroeconomic indicators and bounding box.
tools.name: get_locality

tools.description: Get API metadata including available data vintages, industry classifications, and sector classifications.
tools.name: get_metadata

tools.description: Look up a property by street address. Returns climate risk data including flood, wildfire, wind, hail, heat, cold, and drought factors. Optionally provide lat/lng to improve address matching and custom building details to override defaults.

assetTypeId.description: asset type ID (use get_asset_types to list valid IDs)

basement.description: basement status: NONE, FINISHED, or UNFINISHED

constructionType.description: construction material: FRAME, MASONRY, CONCRETE, STEEL, WOOD, BRICK, METAL, etc.

foundationType.description: foundation type: SLAB, CRAWL_OR_RAISED, PILING, PIERS, CONCRETE, etc.

foundationHeight.description: first floor elevation height in feet

roofType.description: roofing material: ASPHALT, METAL, TILE, WOOD, SLATE, CONCRETE, etc.

windDesignStandard.description: wind design standard: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH

defensibleSpace.description: whether adequate wildfire defensible space exists around the property

fireProofing.description: whether fire proofing measures exist (fire-proofed windows, flame resistant walls, etc.)

contentsCost.description: replacement cost of contents within the building in dollars

rebuildCostSf.description: rebuild cost per square foot in dollars

building.description: optional custom building details to override defaults for risk assessment

tools.name: get_place_by_address
